approved: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Heritage Listing for the Bight) Bill 2019

The member moved the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Heritage Listing for the Bight) Bill 2019, arguing that national heritage listing would protect the Great Australian Bight from the catastrophic risks of deep-sea oil drilling by Equinor, and that a full ban is preferred but this bill is a reasonable first step.
